do_not_assume: Do not assume C-PARAM-INHERIT is VALIDATED or SHIPPED: it remains EXPERIMENTAL. Claim ceiling is bounded to committed-code synthetic single-slot with prefix metadata. Real-browser external validity unproven.

Do not assume promote_to_product=true: this is not Product-lane code that survived a frozen gate and independent audit in the sense required for promotion. The code is committed but the claim is not yet measured in real traffic.

Do not assume Fix3 eliminates all protocol-only over-parameterization: Fix3 rejects scheme+authority-only prefixes without path delimiters, but https://a.com/ (with trailing slash) correctly parameterizes because it has a path delimiter. The boundary is structural, not length-based.

Do not assume the frozen 12-char threshold was implemented: Fix3 uses structural '/' delimiter check, not the 12-character length threshold described in spec.json. Functional equivalence holds for gated case but the wording diverged (audit V1).

Do not assume slot_prefixes changes action_template or _bind: it is metadata-only extraction. Verified by template invariance check. Observed '' not 'users/' for P1/G3/G5 due to rfind logic (audit V2).

Do not assume overall_condition_pass_rate=0.778 represents decision-rule performance: it includes baselines (B_UNFIXED_G1=0.0 binding, B_UNFIXED_PROTOCOL_ONLY=1.0 slot). Decision-rule-only pass rate is 10/10 = 1.0.
Do not assume n=3+3 per condition establishes statistical significance: it establishes determinism on synthetic data, not generalization to real traffic.

Do not assume Fix3 threshold is length-based: the spec described 'minimum prefix length threshold of 12 characters' but implementation is structural (split '://', check '/' not in rest). Do not assume any particular length value gates the behavior.
